name: computer_click
description: Click at pixel coordinates (x, y) of the most recent computer_observe result. Returns whether the input was delivered to the runtime, which is not the same as the click achieving your goal: observe again to confirm what changed.

x.description: Pixels from the left edge of the last observation.

y.description: Pixels from the top edge of the last observation.

click_count.description: 1 single, 2 double click (the protocol has no triple click).
